')!important;
 background-position:center top!important;background-size:cover!important;filter:saturate(.42)!important;
}
.brand-banner.master-brand{
 background:linear-gradient(112deg,#1a252e 0%,#182129 64%,#161e26 100%)!important;
 border-color:rgba(211,195,166,.22)!important;
}
.brand-banner.master-brand .hero-titles h1{color:#f4f0e9!important}
.brand-banner.master-brand .over{color:#e2cda9!important}
/* Main glass cards: dark mineral charcoal, with almost no blue tint. */
.p5-si-card,.card,.match-center,.leaderboard-card,.stage1-controls,.roster-registration-list,.setup-card,
.prepare-next,.duel-row,.stage1-rules{
 background:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(39,43,48,.94),rgba(25,29,35,.95))!important;
 border-color:rgba(205,195,178,.24)!important;
 box-shadow:0 9px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.23)!important;
 backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(76%)!important;
 -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(76%)!important;
}
/* Secondary dark surfaces have their own quiet separation. */
.club-board,.match-center .court,.court,.master-stats .stat,.stat,
.prepare-row,.rounds-drawer,.round-fixture,.roster-group,.setup-current-format,
.format-summary,.score-review,.duel-row,.waiting-court,.setup-info,.colors-advanced,
.history-inline-editor,.roster-team-tabs,.roster-team-tab{
 background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(45,49,53,.93),rgba(30,34,39,.95))!important;
 border-color:rgba(183,179,168,.22)!important;
 box-shadow:none!important;
 backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(75%)!important;
 -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(75%)!important;
}
/* All text fields and selects are the warm graphite of Match Control. */
input,select,textarea,.setup-card .p5-date-display,.setup-card input,
.setup-card select,.master-roster-card .p5-dual-pair-row input,
.roster-group .p5-dual-pair-row input,.match-center .court-score-input,
.history-inline-editor>label input,.lineup-fields select,.score-edit input,
.global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-courtrow select{
 background:#262b31!important;border:1px solid #454c54!important;
 color:#eeeae4!important;box-shadow:none!important;
}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:#a2a5aa!important;opacity:1}
.setup-card #matchFormat:has(option:checked[value=""]){color:#adb0b5!important}
.setup-card .p5-date-display>span{color:#adb0b5}
.setup-card .p5-date-shell.has-date .p5-date-display>span{color:#f2eee7}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:2px solid rgba(217,187,146,.69)!important;outline-offset:1px}
.setup-card .p5-date-shell:focus-within .p5-date-display{border-color:#c8aa81!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #c8aa81!important}
/* Champagne primary, slate secondary, subtly outlined selected controls. */
button{background:#323b44;border-color:#69717a;color:#efebe5}
button.primary,.form-actions button.primary,.setup-home-actions button.primary{
 background:linear-gradient(125deg,#d3b78f,#dcc29b)!important;
 border:1px solid #dcc69f!important;color:#222323!important;
 box-shadow:none!important;font-weight:750;
}
button.ghost,.setup-clear-button{
 background:#37414a!important;border:1px solid #77828c!important;
 color:#f0edeb!important;
}
.setup-courts .choice:not(.selected){background:#292e34!important;border:1px solid #555c64!important;color:#e1e2e3!important}
.setup-courts .choice.selected,.roster-team-tab.active,.leaderboard-filter.active{
 background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(190,155,110,.30),rgba(211,181,140,.24))!important;
 border:1px solid #caa97f!important;color:#f0dfc5!important;
}
.over,.setup-card .field>label,.setup-card .courts-field>label,.setup-home-format>label,
.setup-card .setup-header .over,.roster-label,.stage-label .over{color:#d3b991!important}
.setup-card .field>label,.setup-card .courts-field>label,.setup-home-format>label{
 letter-spacing:.105em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
}
h2,h3,.setup-card h2,.match-center-head h2,.leaderboard-title{color:#f1ece5}
/* Menu & Settings stays full-width, matching the master dark card family. */
.global-dock #mainMenu,.global-dock #mainMenu[open]{
 background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(38,43,48,.94),rgba(23,28,34,.96))!important;
 border-color:rgba(201,186,160,.25)!important;
}
.global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-menu{
 background:rgba(26,30,36,.72)!important;border-color:rgba(203,190,171,.20)!important;
}
.global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-content{background:rgba(12,15,20,.29)!important}
.global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-icon{background:rgba(221,200,167,.055)!important}
.global-dock #mainMenu .p5-4852-section>summary,.global-dock #mainMenu>summary{color:#eee8df!important}
/* Setup: same two-button treatment as the Match Control master. */
.setup-card .setup-home-actions{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);align-items:stretch;gap:10px;margin-top:24px}
.setup-home-actions button{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:53px;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 10px;line-height:1.3}
.setup-home-actions .primary{font-size:13px!important}
.setup-home-actions .setup-clear-button{font-size:13px;font-weight:650}
/* Two clear fields per pair. No instructional paragraph underneath. */
.master-roster-card .roster-registration-list{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(34,39,45,.96),rgba(25,29,34,.97))!important}
.master-roster-card .p5-dual-pair-row input{background:#272c32!important}
@media(max-width:380px){.setup-home-actions button{font-size:12px!important;padding:10px 6px!important}}
@media print{body::before{display:none!important}}



/* v0.8.11 • quiet luxury footer parity + concise Stage 1 dashboard */
footer.foot{
  display:block!important;
  width:100%;
  margin:12px auto 0!important;
  padding:12px 10px 25px!important;
  text-align:center!important;
  color:#d7b98c!important;
  font-size:clamp(9px, .92vw, 12px)!important;
  font-weight:600!important;
  line-height:1.65!important;
  letter-spacing:.18em!important;
  text-transform:uppercase!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}
.round-overview{justify-content:flex-start!important;gap:6px!important}
.stage1-finish-actions{
  margin-top:20px;
  padding:17px 18px;
  border:1px solid rgba(216,188,148,.34);
  border-radius:13px;
  background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(46,44,41,.72),rgba(30,33,36,.85));
}
.stage1-finish-summary{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;margin-bottom:12px}
.stage1-finish-summary strong{color:#e1c097;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em}
.stage1-finish-summary span{color:#d1cbc3;font-size:12px}
.stage1-finish-actions .form-actions{margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stage1-finish-actions .form-actions button{flex:1 1 160px;min-height:44px}
@media(max-width:520px){
  footer.foot{font-size:9px!important;letter-spacing:.12em!important;padding:14px 3px 26px!important}
  .stage1-finish-actions{padding:13px 11px}
}
@media print{footer.foot{display:none!important}}
